name: Tam Bao Meditation Center
about: Tam Bao Meditation Center, also known as Chua Tam Bao, is a Vietnamese Mahayana Buddhist temple in Baton Rouge that has served practitioners from across Louisiana since 1985. The temple grounds include a large meditation hall, a resident monastic dorm housing about a dozen monks, nuns, and novices, a community center, and two log cabins used to house overnight guests. Beyond its regular weekly meditation and chanting services, the abbot, Venerable Thich Dao Quang, personally supports lay practitioners who arrange individual multi-night silent and solitary retreats on the grounds, following an intensive daily schedule of sitting and walking meditation. The temple also runs an annual multi-day residential summer retreat for youth and families with shared lodging and vegetarian meals. As a working temple rather than a formal retreat center, stays are arranged directly with the abbot and supported by dana (voluntary donation).
technique: Vietnamese Zen (Thiền) sitting and walking meditation, chanting, and Dharma study within the Mahayana tradition.
teacherAccess: The abbot, Venerable Thich Dao Quang, and the resident monastic sangha personally support individual retreatants; group events include daily chanting and Dharma talks.
retreatOptions: Weekly evening sits and Sunday chanting/Dharma programs; occasional single-day silent retreats; individually arranged multi-night personal silent retreats (several nights to about a week) in the temple's guest log cabins; an annual multi-day residential summer retreat for youth ages 6-25.
schedule: Individually arranged retreats follow an intensive schedule: pre-dawn rising (around 3-3:30am), several blocks of sitting and walking meditation through the day, two communal vegetarian meals, evening meditation, and lights out by evening.
cost: No fixed fee for individually arranged personal retreat stays; supported by dana (voluntary donation) to the temple.
foodNotes: Retreatants share in the temple's communal vegetarian meals; the annual youth summer retreat serves all-vegetarian meals with dietary accommodations available on request.
workNotes: No published work requirement for individual retreat guests; day-to-day temple upkeep and meal preparation is carried out by the resident monastic sangha and volunteers.
